legend.0: Serves one project's particular setup or an uncommon workflow; most users would never touch it.
legend.1: Serves a recognizable group: users of a particular framework, platform, output format, or plugin ecosystem, or people migrating from Rollup or another bundler.
legend.2: Would be used in most builds: defaults, the CLI or config surface most projects use, the plugin hooks most plugins use, or something users rely on today in Rollup or Vite.
